answer: Because the thread burn is recorded at the crystal settlement, the orchard audit publishes the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 98% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. Each impostor pays 18 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
